          duration: 1.2,
          easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)),
          orientation: 'vertical',
          gestureOrientation: 'vertical',

        })

        function raf(time) {
          lenis.raf(time)
          requestAnimationFrame(raf)
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(raf)
</script>

<script>
    const elementos = document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-left, .scroll-right, .scroll-bottom, .scroll-top, .scroll-opacitiy');
    const posicaoScroll = window.innerHeight * 0.5;
    
    function fadeScroll(){
        elementos.forEach((elemento) => {
            const elementoTop = elemento.getBoundingClientRect().top - posicaoScroll;
        if(elementoTop < 220) {
            elemento.classList.add('ativo');
        }
        else {
            elemento.classList.remove('ativo');
        }
        })
    }
    
    window.addEventListener('scroll', fadeScroll);
</script>

<style>
/* estado inicial + transição suave */
.fade-on-target{
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .35s ease;
  will-change: opacity;
}

/* quando a página estiver entre 20% e 60% de scroll */
.fade-on-target.is-visible{
  opacity: 1;
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  const els = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-on-target');
  if(!els.length) return;

  // thresholds em fração (0..1)
  const SHOW_FROM = 0.05; // 20%
  const HIDE_AFTER = 0.45; // 60%

  let ticking = false;

  function getScrollProgress(){
    const doc = document.documentElement;
    const max = (doc.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
    if (max <= 0) return 1; // página curta: considera 100%
    const y = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0;
    // clamp 0..1
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y / max));
  }

  function applyVisibility(){
    const p = getScrollProgress();

    // visível entre 20% (inclusive) e 60% (exclusivo)
    const visible = (p >= SHOW_FROM && p < HIDE_AFTER);

    els.forEach(el => {
      el.classList.toggle('is-visible', visible);
    });

    ticking = false;
  }

  function onScroll(){
    if (!ticking){
      window.requestAnimationFrame(applyVisibility);
      ticking = true;
    }
  }

  // inicializa e escuta
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyVisibility);
  window.addEventListener('load', applyVisibility);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
})();
</script>
